answer.summary: Revert ORDER_TAX_RATE_BPS in deploy/production.env from 8.25 back to 825, undoing the configuration change in release 2.14.1. The service reads the rate in basis points with int(), so 8.25 fails every order with HTTP 500; 825 is the value it ran with before. Nothing else changes.
